sections.text: Loose residue is collected from the frame, including rails, joints, and the seat support area, before compatible surface cleaning. Fragile finish, heat checks, or loosened joints are identified before treatment. Upholstery receives only the process included in its scope.

sections.title: Reassemble after dry and repair decisions
sections.text: Treated components are dried and inspected for remaining residue, odor, or finish damage. A furniture repairer can address loose joints or replacement seats before the chair returns to use. Cleaning does not establish that heat-damaged construction is structurally sound.

fire-damaged-contents-cleaning/hawk-cove.estimate: Chair construction, finish, upholstery, and disassembly needs shape the scope. Furniture repair and textile replacement are separate.
checklist: List furniture pieces and materials requiring evaluation.
Describe smoke, heat, and water exposure.
Note delicate finishes or prior repair concerns.

fire-extinguisher-residue-cleanup/hawk-c.intro: Fire extinguisher residue cleanup in Hawk Cove can involve powder caught in the folds of a removable fabric window shade. We will distinguish cleanable surrounding trim from a textile whose coating, backing or mechanism may not tolerate ordinary wet cleaning.

sections.title: Fire extinguisher residue cleanup in Hawk Cove: keep the shade extended only as its condition permits
sections.text: We will review the agent information and visible deposits before moving the mechanism. Raising a loaded shade can press residue between folds and transfer it to previously less-affected faces. Fragile fabric, damaged cords or inaccessible upper components may require specialist handling before removal.

sections.title: Evaluate textile recovery separately from the window surround
sections.text: A textile provider can assess suitable treatment or replacement for the shade’s material and construction. We will collect loose residue from the included accessible hard surfaces and clean the trim and sill using a compatible method. A successful wipe on painted trim will not be used to approve wet treatment of the shade.

sections.title: Prevent refitting from recontaminating the cleaned opening
sections.text: Removed components remain separate until their own recovery decision is complete. We will identify powder still lodged in the headrail or mounting recess and any access requiring the shade provider. Cleaned trim is not a reason to reinstall a folded textile that still releases agent.

fire-extinguisher-residue-cleanup/hawk-c.estimate: Agent type, fabric construction, folded surfaces and removal needs determine scope. Textile processing and shade-mechanism service are separate.
checklist: Share the extinguisher label if available.
Identify shade fabric or product details.
Describe whether the shade was raised after the discharge.

emergency-board-up-after-fire/hawk-cove.intro: Emergency board up after fire in Hawk Cove can be needed again when repair work removes the frame that supported an earlier temporary panel. We will reassess the newly exposed opening before deciding whether that panel can be reused or a different closure is needed.

sections.title: Emergency board up after fire in Hawk Cove: review the support left after frame removal
sections.text: The old fastening pattern may end at material that no longer exists. We will measure the current opening and locate suitable sound support, with unresolved structural concerns referred before installation. The previous panel is not assumed to fit simply because it covered the same window before demolition.

sections.title: Inspect reused panels before refitting
sections.text: Split edges, enlarged fastener holes, warping or insufficient overlap can prevent a removed panel from serving the new arrangement. We will replace unsuitable pieces and use an attachment method matched to the support now available. Fasteners will not be driven back into failed holes as a substitute for a secure fit.

sections.title: Check the new closure against the remaining repair work
sections.text: Fitted edges and attachment will be checked for gaps and movement, and authorized access will remain coordinated. Later removal or another change to the supporting assembly may require another refit. Temporary closure does not replace frame reconstruction, permanent weather sealing or a separate occupancy decision.

emergency-board-up-after-fire/hawk-cove.estimate: Changed opening dimensions, reusable-panel condition and new attachment locations affect labor. Frame rebuilding and permanent glazing are separate.
checklist: Describe what was removed after the original board-up.
Share safe photographs of the current opening and old panel.
Identify the next repair visit and required access.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/hawk-cove.intro: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Hawk Cove can involve wastewater that contacted a short section of duct insulation below a floor register. We collect accessible sewage and debris, remove affected porous material within the approved area, and clean suitable retained surfaces. Work requiring a mold remediation license is referred to an appropriately licensed partner with provider and scope disclosed.

sections.title: Remove contacted duct insulation from the work area
sections.text: The affected insulation is contained for disposal rather than left above the crawl-space floor. Duct service or replacement is evaluated by the appropriate provider, particularly if contamination reached the interior. We protect the route used to carry removed material out.

sections.title: Collect waste and physically clean the supporting surfaces
sections.text: Accessible wastewater and soil are removed from the included area, followed by physical cleaning of suitable framing and reachable surfaces. Disinfection follows cleaning where appropriate. Contaminated soil or inaccessible areas are identified for a separate method instead of being represented as cleaned.

sections.title: Resolve the source and inspect the remaining route
sections.text: The failed plumbing or drain source is corrected by its provider before the area is returned to use. We identify remaining affected material, damaged supports, and any access limits. Replacement duct insulation and building repairs are separate tasks.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/hawk-cove.estimate: Wastewater boundary, crawl-space access, porous materials, disposal, and duct condition influence the scope. Licensed mold work is performed by the disclosed licensed partner.
checklist: Describe the sewage source and whether it has been repaired.
Identify affected duct, insulation, soil, or framing.
Share crawl-space access and any safety restrictions.
